$description: Reference tier 1: the oxygen reference app's own colour values, verbatim from reference-app@7c1ee7e (src/index.css, src/components/), each with its source line. derived.* are the few values the reference does not state, each saying what it is derived from and why. Never emitted as CSS.

brand.$description: #445dff: FIX, not the reference: the reference's brand is #3550ff in both themes (reference-app@7c1ee7e src/index.css:294). On the dark --muted (#27272a) that measures 2.65:1, under the 3:1 a mark needs (pairs.json, brand on muted; WCAG 1.4.11). #445dff is the nearest step toward white that clears it (3.02), and white on it still reads 4.93:1. Light keeps #3550ff.

brand-hover.$description: rgba(68,93,255,0.9): --brand at 90%: the reference's hover:bg-brand/90 (reference-app@7c1ee7e src/components/ui.ts:587, 1218), on the fixed dark brand

disabled-foreground.$description: #626268: FIX, not the reference: #606066 (reference-app@7c1ee7e src/index.css:257) measures 2.45:1 on the dark field (#252525), under the contract's 2.5 for inactive text (pairs.json). #626268 is the nearest step that clears it (2.53).

destructive-foreground.$description: #0a0a0a: Ink on the dark destructive fill (#fa8e8e): the canvas, reference-app@7c1ee7e src/index.css:68. The reference has no destructive fill.

scrim.$description: rgba(0,0,0,0.5): FIX, not the reference: the reference dims every dialog with black at 0.35 (Modal.tsx:273), and the design system now also blurs the page behind every overlay (--scrim-blur; Mars, 17 Nov). In dark, black at 0.35 leaves the modal's card (#1a1a1a) at 1.16:1 over the dimmed page and black at 0.5 at 1.17, both over the contract's 1.15 floor for a blurred scrim (pairs.json, popover on scrim); 0.5 is a step darker, so the dialog stands off, while the blurred page still reads through it (0.92, the value before the blur, at 1.20, hid it). The light theme keeps the reference's 0.35.

chart-div-neg-3.$description: #fdba74: Diverging, far below: orange-300. The reference has no diverging scale; its warm hue is --wh-loc-attention orange (index.css:833).

chart-div-mid.$description: #3f3f46: Diverging midpoint: zinc-700, a neutral step above --muted (#27272a, index.css:217).

status-info-series.$description: #4f67ff: FIX, not the reference (decision 64, 20 Nov): the chart's info series read --brand (#445dff), which measures 2.73:1 on a selected row (--row-selected over --card), under the 3:1 a chart line needs. #4f67ff is the smallest step lighter that clears it (3.02); --brand itself stays #445dff for buttons. Light keeps --brand.

status-info.$description: #93a2ff: FIX, not the reference (decision 64, 20 Nov): the info ink was --link (#8696ff, reference-app@7c1ee7e src/index.css:300), and the info chip's word on its tint on a selected row (--status-info on --status-info-bg over --row-selected over --card) measured 3.99:1, under 4.5. #93a2ff is the smallest step lighter that clears it (4.51); --link stays #8696ff for links. Light keeps --link.

status-warning-series.$description: #b27a04: FIX, not the reference: #ca8a04 (reference-app@7c1ee7e src/index.css:668) measures 2.72:1 on the light canvas and 2.94 on the card, under the 3:1 a chart mark needs (WCAG 1.4.11); the first fix, #be8204, measured 3.05 / 3.29 there but 2.69 on a selected row (--row-selected over --card). Decision 64 (20 Nov): #b27a04, the smallest step darker that clears the selected row (3.02).

brand-hover.$description: rgba(53,80,255,0.9): --brand at 90%: the reference's hover:bg-brand/90 (reference-app@7c1ee7e src/components/ui.ts:587, 1218)

chart-div-mid.$description: #e4e4e7: Diverging midpoint: zinc-200, a neutral step below --muted (#ececee, index.css:586).

dot-success.$description: #059341: FIX, not the reference: the reference's light dot is #22c55e (reference-app@7c1ee7e src/index.css:424), which measures 1.71:1 on a selected row over the light canvas (2.28 on white), under the 3:1 a status mark needs (WCAG 1.4.11). This is the colour closest to it (OKLab distance) at its own OKLCH hue (149.6 deg; 149.5 once rounded to hex) that clears 3:1 on every light ground a dot sits on, with a ground one 8-bit step darker too: 3.02 on a selected row over the canvas (the worst), 3.15 on the selected segment, 3.39 on --muted and the rail's selected row, 3.70 on the canvas, 4.00 on white. Round 1's #16a34a measured 2.49 and 2.60 there.

This is the colour closest to it (OKLab distance) at its own OKLCH hue (80.2 deg; 80.7 once rounded to hex) that clears 3:1 on every light ground a dot sits on, with a ground one 8-bit step darker too: 3.03 on a selected row over the canvas (the worst), 3.16 on the selected segment, 3.39 on --muted and the rail's selected row, 3.71 on the canvas, 4.00 on white. Round 1's #be8204 measured 2.49 and 2.59 there.

This is the colour closest to it (OKLab distance) at its own OKLCH hue (25.3 deg) that clears 3:1 on every light ground a dot sits on, with a ground one 8-bit step darker too: 3.03 on a selected row over the canvas (the worst), 3.15 on the selected segment, 3.39 on --muted and the rail's selected row, 3.70 on the canvas, 4.00 on white. Dark keeps #ef4444, which clears 3:1 on every dark ground (3.58 at worst).
